      metric_name,
      MIN(metric_value)                            AS min_val, 
      MAX(metric_value)                            AS max_val,
      ROUND(MEAN(metric_value), 2)                        AS mean_val,
      COUNTIF(metric_value is NULL)                AS null_count,
      COUNTIF(metric_value is NULL) / COUNT(*)     AS null_pct,
      COUNTIF(metric_value is NOT NULL)            AS non_null_count,
      COUNTIF(metric_value is NOT NULL) / COUNT(*) AS non_null_pct,
      LIST(DISTINCT experiment_name)               AS unique_experiment,
      COUNT(DISTINCT experiment_name)              AS num_unique_experiment,
      LIST(DISTINCT name1)                         AS unique_varieties,
      COUNT(DISTINCT name1)                        AS num_unique_varieties,
      LIST(DISTINCT location)                      AS unique_locations,
      COUNT(DISTINCT location)                     AS num_unique_locations,
      COUNT(DISTINCT year)                         AS num_unique_year
FROM unpivot_alias
GROUP BY metric_name;
